name: Tim Walz
summary: Walz advocates public investment in education and family welfare, stronger worker protections and an accelerated transition to clean electricity. He supports abortion and LGBT rights, easier voting access and stricter gun regulation while retaining private enterprise and conventional public-safety institutions.
